title: Unique switch at a nonsingular vertex (Theorem U) is reconstructible
statement_en: Theorem U (unique switch, t1.md section 4): every graph G on at least 3 vertices that is two-walk (a, b)-linear for integers a, b (the sum of the degrees of the neighbours of x is a·deg x + b for every x), with a vertex u' such that A_G f = (a − deg u') f has no nonzero integer solution f, and with a card isomorphism α : G − u → G − u' and a neighbour x of u such that α(x) is not adjacent to u', is reconstructible.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => ∃ a b : ℤ, (∀ x : Fin n, ∑ y : Fin n, Set.indicator (G.neighborSet x) (fun y => ((G.neighborSet y).ncard : ℤ)) y = a * ((G.neighborSet x).ncard : ℤ) + b) ∧ ∃ u' : Fin n, (∀ f : Fin n → ℤ, (∀ x : Fin n, ∑ y : Fin n, Set.indicator (G.neighborSet x) f y = (a - ((G.neighborSet u').ncard : ℤ)) * f x) → f = 0) ∧ ∃ u : Fin n, ∃ α : G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∃ x : ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj u x.1 ∧ ¬ G.Adj u' (α x).1)
